headline: Polymarket Suspends Trading Following Third-Party Security Breach
summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket suspended trading after a security breach at a third-party provider led to unauthorized account drains and user losses.
why: Decentralized prediction markets rely heavily on third-party integrations and smart contract security, making breaches critical indicators of platform operational risk.

impacts.name: Crypto and Prediction Markets
impacts.why: Security breaches involving third-party providers raise operational and counterparty risk concerns across decentralized platforms.

why_moved: User asset losses and the subsequent suspension of trading highlight operational and security vulnerabilities, impacting user trust and platform activity.
